name: Honest Abe
bio: Four score and seven rounds ago. Has never told a lie about a headshot.
notes: A Meshy community model, CC0 per the owner (from the owner's Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch; the community model's name as the download names it): rigged in Meshy (the All Animations GLB; its clips are not used). Its rig names its joints the Mixamo way (mixamorig:Hips ...), read as Meshy's. Abraham Lincoln in a stovepipe hat, frock coat and waistcoat. Hands: his right hand's fingers were read as split (the thumb gap) and crumpled into shards, so it bends as a mitten (`mitten`, curl 1.2); his left measures as a fist, and curled fully it bends away from the grip, so curl 0.4. 2026-11-03: large (owner: "should be large model").

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
